description: Defines the 'Answer' entity class for the database model, including mapping annotations, fields, and accessors.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Entity class representing an 'Answer' in the database, extending the audit model and linked to a question.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates a Question entity with this answer.
